title: Bimar Nainawa Se Is tarha Ja Raha Hai
body:
Paoun Me Bediyan Hai Zanjeer Ki Sada Hai
Bimar Nainawa Se Is-tarha Ja-Raha Hai
Sham-e-ghariban Aaye Baade Hussain Aakhir
Bimar –e-karbala Ab Har Gham Utha Raha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Mashk O Alam Uthake Zanheer Ko Sambhale
Darbar-e-wsham Main Ab Bimar Aaraha Hai
Wo Sham Ka Hai Zindan Jiski Sakina Mehmaan
Abid Garib Uska Turbat Banaraha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahle Haram Ne Payee Jiske Sabab Rehaee
Chuykar Ye Qafila Ab Karbal Ko Jaraha Hai
Ahle Haram Ke Hamra Abid Garib Aaye
Rona Garib Ka Ab Sabko Rularaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Saugaht-e-gham Dikhake Rudad-e-garib Sunake
Bewaoun Ka Qafila Youn Chelum Manaraha Hai
Wapas Waran Ko Apne Kunba Ko Apne Khoke
Iqbal Qafila Ab Kehdo Ke Jaraha Hai
